classification.rationale: An analytical sales report presenting metrics, findings and recommendations.

summarization.headline: Lumen Home Appliances grew Q2 2025 revenue to $12.4 million, led by the new SmartCool line.
key_points: Revenue up 8% quarter over quarter and 15% year over year.
Online sales grew 22% and are now 41% of revenue.
summarization.title: Q2 2025 Sales Performance Report
key_findings: SmartCool generated $3.1 million in its first full quarter
Retail partner sales fell 3%, concentrated in the Midwest
Customer acquisition cost rose 11% due to digital advertising prices
recommendations: Expand SmartCool marketing into Canada in Q3
Renegotiate co-marketing terms with two underperforming retail chains
Shift 10% of paid-search budget to email retention
